Questions

Frequently asked questions

Does this replace hiring a priest?

No. Vedic Pooja Guru is a companion for families who want to perform rituals themselves — it's built to guide, not to replace the tradition or a priest when you want one. A Priest-on-Call option will also be available for occasions where you'd prefer a human touch.

Is the ritual guidance accurate?

Every vidhi, mantra, and item list is reviewed by priests or trusted traditional sources before it's added. Our AI assistant answers questions using this verified content — it doesn't improvise rituals on its own.

Which regional traditions are supported?

We're launching with South Indian, North Indian, Bengali, and Maharashtrian variants for our core poojas, with more regional traditions added over time based on demand.

What languages will the app support?

English and Hindi at launch, with additional regional languages — including audio narration — rolling out shortly after.

Will it work without an internet connection?

Offline access to your saved poojas is on our roadmap, so you're not caught without guidance if you lose signal mid-ritual.

When can I try it?

We're in active development. Join the waitlist below and you'll be among the first to know when early access opens.
